profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at Olo
profile.summary: 9+ years of architecting scalable, accessible software systems for high-growth companies. Proven expertise leading cross-functional initiatives, mentoring engineering teams, and driving architectural decisions that directly impact business outcomes. Specialized in React/NextJS ecosystems with deep full-stack capabilities and accessibility-first development practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Git · .NET Framework · Next.js · User Interface Design · ASP.NET Core · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · TypeScript

positions.title: Front-End Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Git · .NET Framework · User Interface Design · ASP.NET Core · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · TypeScript

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description:
•	Started as part of the Flex Team, which required extreme adaptability to jump in and out of different tech stacks and languages to complete the variety of projects that came to the team.
•	Honed my JavaScript skills by focusing on vanilla JavaScript and ES6.
•	Worked in popular JavaScript frameworks such as React.js and Vue.js
•	Wrote APIs using Node.js and Express. 
•	Used APIs to build data-driven web apps.
•	Gained experience writing asynchronous code with callbacks, ES6 promises and using Async/Await
•	Gained experience using JavaScript task runners such as, Gulp and Grunt.
•	Operated as sole developer on projects, as well as part of a team of developers for bigger projects.
•	Worked closely with the QA team to ensure that projects were free of bugs and production ready. 
•	Worked closely with Creative and UX teams to convert wireframes, PSDs, and Sketch files to fully responsive and interactive websites and web apps.
•	Became a resource for other tech team members when they had questions regarding JavaScript and GIT.
•	Built websites in ASP.net MVC using C# and Razor syntax.
•	Built websites using Umbraco CMS
•	Built authentication system with PHP

positions.title: Web Development Internship
positions.description:
•	Work with Marketing and Communication department to update and maintain the Idaho State University website. 
•	Redesign existing, non-responsive webpages to create responsive webpages using Twitter bootstrap.
•	Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to make updates to webpages for the various departments and colleges at ISU.
•	Make responsive templates to be used in the new Content Management System.
•	Convert PSD to HTML.

positions.title: Merchandising Manager
positions.description:
•	Maintained content on Lithia of Pocatello’s website.
•	Managed SEO for Lithia’s Website.
•	Created content for Social Media to promote and market Lithia of Pocatello.
•	 Filmed and edit videos to post on Lithia of Pocatello’s YouTube and Facebook pages. 
•	Managed various marketing campaigns and strategies. 
•	Created Flyers and advertisements using Photoshop

positions.title: Web Development Internship
positions.description:
•	Used Grails, a MVC framework, to develop an EBay like auction web application for a local business.
•	 Used GIT to maintain the web application with team members.
•	Developed a mobile friendly front-end using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Twitter bootstrap.
•	Communicated with Clients and team members in a professional manner.
